name: Trinity Precision Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Trinity Precision Technology Co., Ltd. is engaged in the design, production, and distribution of powder metal components and gearboxes, primarily focusing on the Taiwanese market. Their offerings are integral to a vast array of products, including power, hand, and garden tools; various home appliances like floor washing machines and sewing machines; electronics and 3C items; sports equipment and massage guns; as well as automotive, motorcycle, and e-bike auto-shifting systems, and automated storage/retrieval mechanisms. Established in 1993, the company is headquartered in Toufen, Taiwan.
